---
title: "Projects"
---

Here is a toy analysis of the mtcars dataset.


```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
mtcars %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mpg = mean(mpg),
    median_mpg = median(mpg),
    sd_mpg = sd(mpg)
  ) |> 
    knitr::kable(caption = "Summary of mtcars dataset")

mtcars %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mpg)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "blue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Miles Per Gallon (mpg)",
       x = "Miles Per Gallon (mpg)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()
```
